items.title: Court Rental
items.text: Book by the hour, indoor or outdoor. Rackets and balls available on site.
items.alt: Padel racket and ball on a court, beside the net

items.title: Coaching
items.text: One-to-one and small-group sessions with qualified padel coaches.
items.alt: Close view of a player with a padel racket and ball

items.title: Classes
items.text: Beginner and intermediate group classes, run weekly on Monday to Thursday evenings.
items.alt: Four players with rackets on an indoor padel court

items.title: Tournaments & Events
items.text: Friday club nights, monthly ladders and open tournaments.
items.alt: Racket meeting the ball during a padel match
